mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ refers to what is of benefit to the entire Christian community, to build it up.
An act of ministry refers to what is of benefit to the entire Christian community, to build it up.
Fill in the blank: ______ is considered as a ministry on its own in the New Testament (1 Cor 12:28).
Pastoral administration is considered as a ministry on its own in the New Testament (1 Cor 12:28).
Fill in the blank: ______ can be defined as a practical theological discipline which focuses on the ministry or care of souls.
Pastoral Theology can be defined as a practical theological discipline which focuses on the ministry or care of souls.
Fill in the blank: ______ is an experience of being overcome with such a powerful emotion that a person's self control and reason is momentarily suspended.
Ecstasy is an experience of being overcome with such a powerful emotion that a person's self control and reason is momentarily suspended.
fib: ______ is the fact that the expression gifts of healing is endered in the plural.
Notable is the fact that the expression gifts of healing is endered in the plural.
______ is the vocation, privilege and responsibility of all baptized Christians.
Ministry is the vocation, privilege and responsibility of all baptized Christians.
______ is the bedrock of all pastoral ministries.
Service of God and neighbour is the bedrock of all pastoral ministries.
______ is the act of public proclamation of the good news of salvation.
Preaching is the act of public proclamation of the good news of salvation.
